title: Mere Sai
desc: The show traces journey of Sai Baba of Shirdi,a fakir who after witnessing injustices due to religious and caste discrimination, faces several trials and tribulations on his journey to bring peace.

title: Brahma Vishnu Mahesh
desc: Narad extols Ansuya's loyalty; goddesses' husbands become babies. Ansuya keeps them as infancy avatars, forming Dattatreya; Nahush grows, loves Sundari, while Hund abducts.

title: Maa Shakti
desc: Maa Shakti takes fierce forms to fight evil and restore balance. Witness her divine strength, compassion, and power as she protects life from darkness.

title: Jai Ganga Maiya
desc: On Bhagirath's request, Lord Brahma orders Ganga, a goddess born from the divine feet of Vishnu and sustained in Lord Shiva's locks, to bless and protect the humans on Earth.

title: Shree Krishna
desc: Krishna grows from a naughty boy to the prince of Mathura and Dwarka, then goes on adventures to fight evil forces and protect people everywhere, always.

title: Ramayan
desc: A religious scholar delivers discourses based on the verses in the Ramayana and inspires devotees to follow a spiritually balanced and righteous life.

title: Om Namah Shivay
desc: A devotional series that explores the divine energy of Lord Shiva, Om Namah Shivay presents mythological stories, hymns, and spiritual journeys of devotees.

title: Karmadhikari Shanidev
desc: Narada, angered by Shanidev's elevated status, challenges Narayan. Narayan defends Shanidev, rationalizing his past and current position with sound reasoning and divine understanding.

title: Maharana Pratap
desc: Young prince Pratap, a fearless patriot and warrior, loves his land dearly. Guided by his mother Jaivantabai and Guru Raghavendra, he upholds noble ideals and the spirit of courage.

title: Jai Bhairavnath
desc: Three childhood friends grow apart when secrets and loyalties strain their bond, forcing them to confront what loyalty means and whether friendship can survive challenges.
